claims.statement: In FY 2026-27, the API business will focus on maintaining a strong market position in top 10 APIs, bringing new business on board, and enhancing market presence.
claims.quote: In FY 2026-27, API business will continue to focus on maintaining a strong market position in top 10 APIs and bringing new business on board with new pipeline molecules and enhancing its market presence via organic launches, partnering with innovators and deepening its footprint by increasing outreach to newer untapped markets.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: The company plans to enhance its API R&D and manufacturing capacities.
claims.quote: The Company plans to enhance its API R&D and manufacturing capacities.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The Company achieved PAT amounting to 3,879 crores in FY 2025-26, representing 13.8% of global revenue.
facts.quote: The Company achieved PAT amounting to J 3,879 crores in FY 2025-26 which is 13.8% of global revenue.

facts.statement: Jay Precision Pharmaceuticals Private Limited acquired a 26% stake in AMPIN Energy C&I Eighteen Private Limited, making it an associate.
facts.quote: Jay Precision Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, subsidiary of the Company acquired 26% stake in AMPIN Energy C&I Eighteen Private Limited on 28th May, 2025, making it an associate of the Company.

facts.statement: CiplaRna GmbH was incorporated in Germany as a wholly owned subsidiary of Cipla (EU) Limited.
facts.quote: Incorporation of CiplaRna GmbH in Germany as wholly owned subsidiary of Cipla (EU) Limited, UK, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company w.e.f. 28th May, 2025.

facts.statement: The company acquired 100% stake in Inzpera Healthsciences Limited making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
facts.quote: Acquired 100% stake in Inzpera Healthsciences Limited ("Inzpera") making it a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company w.e.f 4th December, 2025.

facts.statement: Cipla Middle East Company was incorporated in Saudi Arabia as a wholly owned subsidiary of Cipla (EU) Limited.
facts.quote: Incorporation of Cipla Middle East Company in Saudi Arabia as wholly owned subsidiary of Cipla (EU) Limited, UK, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company w.e.f. 1st March, 2026.

facts.statement: The Company and Kemwell Biopharma Private Limited incorporated a new joint venture named Aspergen Limited in India.
facts.quote: The Company and Kemwell Biopharma Private Limited incorporated a new joint venture company named Aspergen Limited in India, with effect from 5th May, 2026 with a shareholding structure of 60% by the Company and 40% by Kemwell Biopharma Private Limited.
